scope: Synthetic local capacity, refusal, restart serialization, authority and shell-cache evidence. The device shows pending counts and refuses additions when an available StorageManager cannot provide durable measurable capacity, without mutating existing unsent work.
limits: Physical reference-device quota, browser eviction behavior, formal QA/domain approval, CI, merge and observed deployment remain separate. Browsers without StorageManager retain the legacy warning path and require separate approved-device qualification.
